entities.summary: West Indies Federation, a political institution in Trinidad and Tobago during Oil Discovery, Labour Movement, and Independence (1950–1962). Grew from Universal adult suffrage granted 1946 and Butler Riots and the Labour Movement. Led to the emergence of People's National Movement and Eric Williams.
